Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in its initial analysis by incorrectly naming the foundry as the "West Point Foundry Association." The correct name, confirmed by the WebSurfer's search results (Wikipedia and Scenic Hudson), is simply the "West Point Foundry." The "Association" is likely a confusion with the West Point Foundry Association (a historical society or group), not the name of the 19th-century industrial facility itself. This error was introduced immediately in the first step when the Planner formulated its updated understanding and decided to mark the task as complete with the wrong name.
